Why OPUS Plasma

A Needle-Free Alternative to Botox & Eye Lift Surgery

vs. Injectables

No needles, no filler, no toxin. OPUS stimulates your own skin to repair itself rather than freezing muscles or adding volume — results build over weeks and look natural.

vs. Surgical Eye Lift

Blepharoplasty means incisions, stitches and weeks of recovery. Opus Colibri targets the same area non-surgically, with 2–3 days of typical swelling instead of weeks.2

vs. Laser Resurfacing

Traditional laser resurfacing can mean a week or more of downtime. OPUS Plasma controls energy-to-tissue contact time precisely, cutting recovery roughly in half.1

Questions

OPUS Plasma FAQ

What is skin resurfacing?+
Skin resurfacing creates a controlled pattern of microscopic injury to a fraction of the skin, triggering your body's natural repair response. OPUS Plasma delivers this using a precisely controlled plasma energy source rather than a traditional laser.
How is OPUS different from a laser?+
Traditional lasers deliver intense heat that can cause longer inflammation and downtime. OPUS Plasma precisely controls the energy-to-tissue contact time, which is what produces roughly 50% less downtime compared to a fractional laser in published clinical data.1
What is Opus Colibri, and how is it different from the face treatment?+
Colibri is a precision 0.7mm tip built specifically for the eye area, used on the same OPUS platform. It's designed to treat upper lid hooding, fine lines and under-eye texture — areas too delicate for the standard face tips.
Is the treatment painful?+
A topical anesthetic is typically applied before treatment to minimize discomfort. Most clients describe mild warmth or pressure during the session.
What does recovery look like?+
For facial treatments, expect 24–48 hours of mild to moderate redness and swelling — usually not significant enough to interfere with daily activities. For the eye area, expect 2–3 days of swelling with redness generally settling within a week.2
How many sessions will I need?+
Many clients see noticeable improvement after their first treatment. A series of 2–3 sessions is typically recommended for optimal results, with your treatment plan personalized during consultation.
Am I a good candidate?+
OPUS Plasma is designed to be versatile across age groups, skin types and concerns, and is safe on all skin tones. Your practitioner can adjust the energy level to personalize your treatment. A free consultation will confirm whether it's right for you.
